title: The Founder's messages: Open it goes where they're about, and the words come clean
why: The site's email to the Founder for a session manager's message (FounderMail::messages, notify-founder) always ended "Open it: https://traversence.com/admin/config/control?tab=development", a dead end for a message about anything else (the session manager, 2026-11-27, after the Wix and Squarespace comparison's PDF link; CLAUDE.md "Never a dead end"). Option (a), the session manager's ruling for the PM (8), 2026-11-27: each releases/batch.json message may carry an optional link and an optional task. Open it goes to its link when it's one of ours (a /path on our site, or https on traversence.com, staging.trvgo.us or github.com/degraffics/); else to its Work queue ticket, ...?tab=development#wq-<task>, as a decision's email already does (FounderMail.php:79); else to the Work queue, as before. A link not ours is dropped, never sent. gauges.py carries both and warns, never refuses, when a message has neither. Backend only: an email's link, no page changes. Gate: none directly; it serves the Founder's daily launch reporting (0181 §2: what reaches Jason), so his messages open where they're about. IT Manager's (11) lane. Also (Jason, 2026-11-27: "The push is clutter with code vs a clean on brand message"; recorded as Operations & Policy (16); the standard is the CMO's (7) and Editorial's (12); the session manager confirmed the design for the PM (8)): for the three founder.* kinds only, the push is the subject and one plain sentence, its links by their names, with no address or code, at most 140 characters, and it opens to the message's place. The email gains an HTML part on brand (Mailer's code-email colours): each link shown as its name, Open it as a button, and a footer link to change what reaches him. The text part keeps each address after its name, for mail apps without HTML. Pulse shows the same named links. A body writes a link as [its name](address). A bare address after a phrase ("Approve it on the Work queue: https://…") takes the phrase as its name; otherwise it's named by where it goes ("Open it on Traversence", "Open it on staging", "Open it on GitHub": a suggestion for the CMO and Editorial in the Design review). Every other kind is unchanged: notify-diff.php proves Notify.php is live's byte for byte once the three founder.* additions are taken out. Tier 3, IT Manager's (11) lane.

changes.what: A session manager's email to the Founder opens its own link or its Work queue ticket, not always the Work queue
Pushes to the Founder: the subject and one plain sentence, no address or code; emails to him: links by their names, Open it as a button
